pages.title: Mowzie's Mobs
pages.text: **Mowzie's Mobs** adds animated creatures and four bosses, each tied to a structure, with masks, weapons and armor you can wear.

Structures: the **Wrought Chamber** (Ferrous Wroughtnaut, an armored iron golem), the **Umvuthana Grove** and **Monastery** (Umvuthi, the Sunbird, and his tribe), and the Frostmaw's spawns in snowy places. Tongbi, the Sculptor, is the fourth boss.

pages.title: Sol Visage
pages.text: Umvuthi's mask. The Umvuthana masks (Fury, Fear, Rage, Bliss, Misery, Faith) are worn for abilities.

pages.title: Earthrend Gauntlet
pages.text: The Sculptor's gauntlet. The Geomancer set (staff, robe, beads) is his too.
Smaller mobs: Foliaath, Lantern, Grottol (a mineral creature), Bluff, Naga and Elokosa. Frostmaw's Ice Crystal is a weapon. Bosses: [#](2E5AAC)[Bosses](entry://exploration/bosses)[#]().
Tuned in this pack: the Ferrous Wroughtnaut, Umvuthi, Frostmaw and the Sculptor have 0.7x health and 0.75x damage. They are softened, not removed, and their structures still generate.
